in_urdu.name: دلبر

Delbar is also the name of a town in present-day Afghanistan, which was the capital of the Ghaznavid Empire under Sultan Mahmud in the late 10th and early 11th century. It was a major center of Islamic learning and culture, with numerous madrasas and mosques.
